axes_source: Read from data/brands/revolut.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #494FDF and the canvas #000000; contrast from the ink #191C1F on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #494FDF; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 8, 12, 20, 28px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #494FDF reaches 3.47:1 on the canvas #000000, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
